rows.en: Mass driver halts as time passes
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Intel says a Giganos transport unit has returned to the <pic(0)><cs(3)>Giganos Lunar Empire<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: It's almost certain that the E2 has passed into Giganos hands.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: If it's used in their trump card, the <pic(1)><cs(3)>mass driver<ce()>, Earth's survival will be at stake.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: <mk(37.5,-37.5,5,3)><ar(0,5,3,200)><mk(37.5,-75,5,3,50)><ar(0,5,3,200)><mk(75,-37.5,5,3,100)><ar(0,5,3,200)>In response, the UCE Space Force will now move to subdue the Giganos Lunar Empire.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: To prevent the worst from happening, this operation must succeed, no matter what.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa

rows.en: With this operation's success, the Giganos Lunar Empire is now occupied by our UCE.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: However, the E2 had already been carried off by the forces that fled.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: They're likely headed to the Giganos Space Fortress... We're doing all we can to find it.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: I promise to inform you the moment any information comes in.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Three of the E2 are still in enemy hands. Stay sharp and continue your pursuit mission.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: Just what do you think you are doing? Is that all the strength you have?
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail

rows.en: You carry the future of Earth. This simply will not do. Pull yourselves together.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail
